correctness.rationale: Ind_2 permits induced components of size at most two, equivalently forbids an induced length-two path triple; the frozen package correctly uses 42 such triples on C7 □ K2. Independent graph and complete nonempty-mask enumerations for n=3,4,5,6 give reduced Euler characteristics (-4,3,-11,-10), all different from ±1 and hence prohibit spheres. For n=7 independent enumeration yields exactly 2,044 nonempty faces with f=(14,91,322,644,658,287,28). Independently replayed the explicitly specified pivot order (11,4,0,8,9,1,2,7,3,12,13,6,10,5), finding 1,021 pairs, one critical vertex and one critical 5-simplex. Acyclicity is certified by the full 8,932-incidence directed Hasse topological sort over 2,044 faces. Forman yields an integral S^5 (not just homology). For n>7 no conclusion is claimed.
